verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: Take Aaron and his sons with him. Also take the sacred garments, the oil for anointing, the grain offering, the two goats, and the basket containing the offerings.
verses.3: And all the congregation gathered at the entrance of the tabernacle.
verses.4: And Moses did as Jehovah commanded him. Then the assembly gathered at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
verses.5: And Moses said to the assembly, “This is what the LORD has commanded to be done.”
verses.6: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward, and he bathed them in the water.
verses.7: And he gave him the crown. Then he bound him with it. He covered him with the cloak. And he gave him the beard and bound it around his head. Then he shaved off his beard.
verses.8: And he put the lamp on it, and he gave the lamps to it, along with the candles and the tumbrels.
verses.9: And he put the crown on his head. On the crown, he placed the golden wreath that was a sacred ornament, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.10: And Moses took the holy oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything that was inside it. He sanctified them thereby.
verses.11: And he poured oil on the altar seven times. Then he anointed the altar and all its utensils, as well as the laver and the basin, for their consecration.
verses.12: And he poured the honey onto Aaron’s head, and he anointed him for sanctification.
verses.13: And Moses brought the sons of Aaron forward, and he ordered them to wear special garments. He also made them wear belts, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
verses.14: And he removed the branch of sin. Then Aaron and his sons placed their hands on the head of the branch of sin.
verses.15: And Moses slaughtered the animal, took some of its blood, and applied it to the horns of the altar. Then he sprinkled the blood on the altar’s surface. In this way, he made the altar holy for use as a sacred place.
verses.16: And he took all the milk that was on the shelves, as well as the remaining butter and the two pots. Then Moses boiled it all.
verses.17: And the grain, and the vineyard, and all its produce—these were burned by fire from outside the camp, just as Jehovah commanded Moses.
verses.18: And he brought the ram that was to be sacrificed. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.19: And Moses sprinkled the blood on the altar around it.
verses.20: And the altar was set up for his use. Moses cut off the top part of it, along with all the other parts of it.
verses.21: And he bathed himself in the waters, and Moses burned all the offerings that were to be offered. He smelled the fragrance of those offerings, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
verses.22: And he brought the second bull to the altar. Aaron and his sons placed their hands on the head of the bull.
verses.23: And Moses cut it open, and took some of its blood. He applied that blood to the tip of Aaron’s right ear, as well as to his right hand and right foot.
verses.24: And Moses brought the children of Aaron forward. He applied the blood to their right ears, right hands, and right feet. Then Moses spread the blood all over the altar.
verses.25: He took the milk, along with all the milk that was on the surface. He also took the remaining cream, along with the two cheeses.
verses.26: And from the vessels that were taken before Jehovah, he took one jar of honey and one jar of flour. He also took one spoonful of it, and he poured it onto the milk and on the left side of the vessel.
verses.27: And he placed everything on Aaron’s and his sons’ shoulders. Then he blessed them before Jehovah.
verses.28: And Moses took them from their heads, and he burned the incense on the altar. It was meant to serve as an offering for God.
verses.29: And Moses took the Urim and called it before Jehovah. It was a standard, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
verses.30: And Moses took the honey from the honeycomb, as well as the blood that was on the altar. He put it on Aaron’s clothes, on his sons’ clothes, and on the clothes of his sons. Thus, he sanctified Aaron’s clothes, his sons’ clothes, and the clothes of his sons.
verses.31: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, “Prepare the offerings for the LORD. There, you shall eat them and also the bread that is on the altar. As I commanded you, Aaron and his sons shall eat them.”
verses.32: And the bones and the flesh will be burned by fire.
verses.33: And from the entrance of the tent of the priest, they shall not go out for seven days, until the day when their time is fulfilled. For during these seven days, their hands will be filled with work.
verses.34: On this day, when He did this, the LORD commanded that you should carry it upon your shoulders.
verses.35: And they shall open the doors of the tabernacle. They shall dwell there day and night, for seven days. And they shall keep the laws of Jehovah. They shall not die, for that is what I have commanded.
verses.36: And Aaron and his sons did all the things that Jehovah had commanded Moses to do.
